newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba-forex rates now better reflect fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Buba-forex rates now better reflect fundamentals.

text.p: The Bundesbank said in a report released on Thursday that current exchange rates matched economic fundamentals far better than in 1995, when several countries' currencies had been hit by a loss of confidence.

"Exchange rate relations at present far better reflect fundamental economic factors that in 1995, when several partner countries's currencies suffered from a loss of confidence caused by political factors," the Bundesbank said in its September monthly report.
The report was completed before this week's appreciation of the dollar.

The bank also said that despite the appreciation of the mark in the summer months of 1996, its value against the 18 most important currencies at the time the September report was completed was about two percent lower than at the start of 1996.
